3277-4875-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
3277-4875-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Conspiracy, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Izzet Chronarch token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

339-677-1322-8249.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

240-5470-7060-8250.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4184-6972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Relentless Skaabs
When Relentless Skaabs dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Relentless Skaabs
When Relentless Skaabs dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Hammerhead abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
4184-6972-8095.notes: If Relentless Skaabs starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

851-3129-6664-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2557-4094-5478-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2
2557-4094-5478-6753-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature that has power 2 or greater

1809-1987-7907.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1809-1987-7907.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Returned Pastcaller.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1809-1987-7907.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

2999-3375-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Impassioned Orator trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Impassioned Orator trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
2999-3375-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

2557-5742-5743-7435.description:
Activate Hardened Academic by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Hardened Academic ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

891-1258-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Abduction triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2493-4050-7364.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Archaeomancer and another nontoken creature, adding {1}{W}.
Cast Continue? by paying {1}{W}, returning Archaeomancer and at least one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Archaeomancer enters, it triggers, returning Continue? from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
2493-4050-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to two additional creatures each loop to net mana.

3991-4605-5231-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {4}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Faceless Butcher and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Faceless Butcher.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
3991-4605-5231-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5256-5434-5555-6922.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
5256-5434-5555-6922.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
5256-5434-5555-6922.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Karlov Watchdog and causing you to draw a card.
During the opponent's turn, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

2173-4771-5220-6578.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
2173-4771-5220-6578.notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.

3593-4050-4359.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Garna, adding {R}.
Resolve the Garna trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
3593-4050-4359.notes: You can repeat this loop with any number of additional creatures. This will require the desired creatures to either be on the battlefield already, or to be in your hand with an additional {R} available for each creature. Simply play all other creatures with Sneak Attack before Garna, and then make sure to sacrifice them all for {R} before resolving Garna's trigger.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

647-3259-6664.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control five or more Towns.
647-3259-6664.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Wandering Minstrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

474-4394-4452-5231.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Specimen Collector, adding {R}.
When Specimen Collector dies, its second ability triggers, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Specimen Collector from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Specimen Collector enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

4315-5149-5200.easyPrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Sword of the Paruns.
4315-5149-5200.notablePrerequisites: Sword of the Paruns and Careful Cultivation attached to the same creature you control that does not have summoning sickness.
4315-5149-5200.description:
Activate the creature with both permanents attached to it using the ability from Careful Cultivation by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns's first activated ability by paying {1}, untapping the creature.
Repeat.
4315-5149-5200.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

101-372-4598.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Essence Flux exiled by Abdel Adrian.
101-372-4598.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Vampire Charmseeker and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Vampire Charmseeker trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Essence Flux.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Vampire Charmseeker and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2066-2757-3995.easyPrerequisites: Fertile Ground attached to a basic land you control.
2066-2757-3995.description:
Activate the basic land with Fertile Ground attached by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Fertile Ground triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Horseshoe Crab, untapping the basic land.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
If the basic land is an Island, you may add mana of any color using Fertile Ground's trigger, and you may infinitely repeat steps 3-4 with any other basic land you control.

1127-2440-4055.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Spirits.
1127-2440-4055.description:
Activate Blinking Spirit by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying {3}{W}.
When Blinking Spirit enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Energy Refractor by paying {2}, adding {W}.
Repeat.
If you control six or more Spirits, this combo nets infinite mana.

2757-4878-5285.notablePrerequisites:
Market Festival attached to a basic land.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
2757-4878-5285.description:
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Market Festival triggers, adding {1}{W}.
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Angel, untapping the basic land.
Repeat.

1202-2055-2146-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel, adding {W}.
Myr Moonvessel dies, adding {C}.
Activate Auriok Salvagers by paying {1}{W}, returning Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Moonvessel by paying {0}.
Repeat.

803-1486-4091.notablePrerequisites:
Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
803-1486-4091.description:
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting itself.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

1052-3175-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Repeat.

2484-2615-3799.notablePrerequisites:
Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.
Enough mana to cast Blasphemous Act.
2484-2615-3799.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, targeting your opponent and setting their life total to 13.
Cast Blasphemous Act, dealing 13 damage to Stuffy Doll.
Stuffy Doll triggers, dealing 13 damage to your opponent.
